prompt:

STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground, muted blue fill accents, soft dark ink line.

Layout: a THREE-PANEL horizontal strip. Three panels of equal size in one horizontal row, separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. A title bar sits in the cream margin above the panels; one short caption sits in the cream gutter under each panel; a footer bar sits in the cream margin below the panels. Text sits only in the cream margins, never over the artwork.

People are ordinary and varied; no recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual. ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem.

The glowing translucent amber laptop from the reference image appears in panels two and three only, the SAME laptop both times, on a radio-studio desk.

BEAT ONE (left panel): a marketing man in a tan blazer tosses banknotes into a bonfire whose smoke curls into the shape of a large megaphone, while behind him a vast crowd of small faceless silhouettes walks past in soft grey, none of them facing him. Beside him a puzzled analyst woman in a navy sweater holds a completely BLANK clipboard, shrugging. The money burns; nothing comes back.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): a warm community radio studio. A woman host with box braids and headphones leans into a microphone mid-question, smiling. A small wall sign behind her reads exactly "COMMUNITY RADIO". Around the edge of the panel, four varied listeners (different ages, skin tones, clothing) hold up phones, each phone emitting a warm amber ribbon of light; the ribbons stream across the panel INTO the glowing translucent amber laptop open on the studio desk. Inside the laptop screen a small rounded commander figure in a gold military cap catches each ribbon and files it into a glowing archive of small drawers that is visibly growing.

BEAT THREE (right panel): the same studio, daytime. A station manager, an older man in a cardigan, leans toward the same glowing amber laptop and speaks to it, hand raised mid-question. The laptop screen answers with a soft luminous map of city neighborhoods dotted with small warm portraits of now-known listeners. At the studio door a visiting sponsor woman in a blazer looks over his shoulder, eyebrows raised, impressed. A small lit sign above the door reads exactly "ON AIR".

Physical relationships: the ribbons in beat two flow FROM the listeners' phones INTO the laptop screen, never the reverse; the archive of drawers inside the screen in beat two is the same archive the map is drawn from in beat three; the crowd in beat one is anonymous and grey precisely because nothing connects them to anyone, in contrast to the known faces on the beat-three map.

Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, and no other text anywhere (the only in-scene text is the "COMMUNITY RADIO" wall sign in the middle panel and the "ON AIR" sign in the right panel):
Title bar above the panels, in caps: "COMPOUNDING CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE"
Caption under the left panel, in caps: "MONEY BURNED, NOTHING LEARNED"
Caption under the middle panel, in caps: "EVERY INTERACTION FEEDS THE LAKE"
Caption under the right panel, in caps: "ASK IT ANYTHING"
Footer bar below the panels, in caps: "STOP PAYING THE BRAND GODS. START COMPOUNDING WHAT YOUR PEOPLE TELL YOU."
